class Direct {
  x: number;
  constructor() {
    try { return; }
    finally { this.x = 1; }
  }
}
class Conditional {
  x: number;
  constructor(flag: boolean) {
    try { if (flag) return; }
    finally { this.x = 2; }
  }
}
class Nested {
  x: number;
  constructor() {
    try {
      try { return; }
      finally {}
    } finally {
      this.x = 5;
    }
  }
}
console.log(new Direct().x, new Conditional(true).x, new Conditional(false).x);
console.log(new Nested().x);
